subject: Workplace Skills
title: Anchoring in Negotiations
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Anchoring in Negotiations.

hook.text: Judges were given random numbers before sentencing. Higher random numbers led to longer sentences. Truly.

buildup.text: Anchoring means the first number presented becomes the reference point. All subsequent judgments adjust from it.

discovery.text: In salary talks, the first number named sets the anchor. Every counteroffer adjusts from that starting point.

twist.text: Even when people know about anchoring, they still fall for it. Awareness reduces but does not eliminate the bias.

climax.text: If you can, make the first offer and back it with data. If they anchor first, explicitly reset the range.

punchline.text: Set the anchor or counter it. Never ignore it.

quiz.question: Can awareness of anchoring fully prevent its effect?
options: Yes, educated people are immune to anchoring
No, awareness reduces but does not eliminate the bias
